origin.claim: This is an independent prospective test of a pilot-derived ecological hypothesis, not a confirmatory re-analysis of the pilot.

ecological_hypothesis.statement: Within larval host-resource opportunity, climatic filtering of realized butterfly distribution weakens as taxonomic host breadth increases.
ecological_hypothesis.mechanistic_interpretation: Host specialists may possess geographically widespread resources yet remain physiologically constrained to a narrower climatic subset, whereas broad host generalists may realize resource opportunity across a wider range of climatic contexts.
ecological_hypothesis.direction: negative association between host-family breadth and climate-filtering strength

independent_panel.source: Exact S1 339-species resource-descriptor reconstruction from workflow run 36222306369.
eligibility_before_new_occurrence_respon: resolved HOSTS-WCVP host-species count >= LepTraits host-family count

axes: z(log1p native host-resource WGSRPD3 unit count)
selection_within_stratum.tie_breaker: SHA256 of fixed selection tag plus species name

occurrence_transport.checkpointing: chunk and completed-window checkpoints; resume unfinished chunks only

resource_envelope.definition: extant and non-doubtful WGSRPD3 distribution of resolved larval hosts, including native and introduced ranges
resource_envelope.reason: modern GBIF occurrence data require contemporary resource opportunity rather than native-only host geography

per_species: resolved host-species count >= LepTraits host-family count
fraction of observed WGSRPD3 units outside contemporary host envelope <= 0.10
at least 5 contemporary host units with >=10 GBIF records from other independent-panel butterflies
among those effort-supported units, at least 2 target-observed and at least 2 target-unobserved units
preclimate_quality_gate.sampling_effort_proxy: sum of GBIF records from the other 31 independent-panel butterflies in the same WGSRPD3 unit

climate_crossfit.observed_unit_split: within each quality-qualified species, deterministic SHA256 50/50 split of observed units inside contemporary host envelope
climate_crossfit.training: climate center and scale estimated only from occurrence records in train-observed units
climate_crossfit.evaluation: compare held-out eval-observed resource units against never-observed contemporary resource units that pass the effort threshold
climate_crossfit.species_climate_filtering_score: P(climate mismatch of never-observed unit > climate mismatch of held-out observed unit) + 0.5*P(tie)

primary_test.statistic: partial Spearman correlation computed by rank-transforming response, predictor and log1p(control), residualizing response and predictor ranks separately on control rank with an intercept, then correlating residuals

permutation.rule: permute host-family breadth labels across climate-informative species while holding response, contemporary resource breadth and quality qualification fixed

decision.support: one-sided permutation p < 0.05 and observed partial Spearman < 0

secondary_descriptive: unadjusted Spearman between climate-filtering score and host-family breadth
Spearman between climate-filtering score and contemporary resource breadth
